# Feature Quality Checklist: SLICE-03 — Chief Leader Appointment & Notification

**Purpose**: Requirements quality gate before task generation
**Created**: 2026-09-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope and Lifecycle

- [x] CHK001 Is the appointment goal defined independently from acceptance and publication? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK002 Is the permitted transition from no unresolved assignment or declined history to a new Pending record explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008/FR-009/FR-018]
- [x] CHK003 Is behavior for an existing Pending or Active assignment unambiguous? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Is the Event's unchanged Draft state stated as an observable result? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are later acceptance, publication, staffing, replacement, and notification-inbox capabilities explicitly excluded? [Scope, Spec §FR-027]

## Actors, Authorization, and Privacy

- [x] CHK006 Are Admin appointment and candidate-pool permissions distinguished from Chief Leader and Leader permissions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Is authoritative save-time authorization specified independently from client presentation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005/FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Are inactive and non-Chief-Leader candidate rules both explicit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003–005]
- [x] CHK009 Is dual-role candidate eligibility consistent with CHANGE-001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Are candidate identity requirements limited to distinguishing, non-sensitive information? [Privacy, Spec §FR-002]

## Integrity, History, and Side Effects

- [x] CHK011 Is the assignment, audit, and notification result defined as one all-or-none business outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–015]
- [x] CHK012 Are exact assignment and notification states/types specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009/FR-013]
- [x] CHK013 Is declined assignment history preservation defined without implying mutation or deletion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK014 Are repeated, uncertain, stale, and concurrent submissions addressed with observable outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016/FR-017]
- [x] CHK015 Is abandonment behavior specified to create no business side effects? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]

## Failure and Recovery

- [x] CHK016 Are not-found, non-Draft, ineligible-candidate, authorization, conflict, and recoverable failures distinguishable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK017 Does every rejection state that existing business data remains unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements for retaining candidate selection and resolving uncertain outcomes documented? [Recovery, Spec §FR-016/FR-022]
- [x] CHK019 Are safe error requirements explicit enough to prevent sensitive implementation disclosure? [Security, Spec §FR-020]

## Mobile and Accessibility

- [x] CHK020 Are minimum touch target, narrow viewport, horizontal-scroll, and visible-action expectations measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK021 Are loading, saving, success, failure, duplicate-submission, and layout-stability requirements complete? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021/FR-025]
- [x] CHK022 Are keyboard, focus, labels, reading order, announcements, contrast, color, text scaling, and reduced-motion expectations defined? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-026]

## Acceptance and Readiness

- [x] CHK023 Does each functional requirement map to at least one acceptance scenario or measurable outcome? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK024 Are success criteria technology-independent and objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK025 Are all assumptions explicit and free of unresolved product decisions? [Readiness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Does the specification avoid persistence, framework, API, and component design choices? [Implementation Independence]
